findings.title: Security Bulletin: Multiple vulnerabilities affect the Sniffer component as part of IBM Guardium Data Protection
findings.summary_md: IBM initially published this security bulletin on 8 October 2026. It lists eleven Sniffer flaws in Guardium Data Protection 12.0, 12.1 and 12.2, led by CVE-2026-75875 (CVSS 9.8, path traversal to arbitrary code execution) and CVE-2026-80381 (CVSS 9.8, unauthorized SQL statements), plus parser bugs such as CVE-2026-82335 in MongoDB SCRAM usernames and CVE-2026-84058 in TDS PRELOGIN packets. IBM directs all affected versions to the SqlGuard_12.0p4018_SnifferUpdate patch and states that no workarounds exist.

findings.title: Security Bulletin: IBM Guardium Data Protection is affected by multiple vulnerabilities
findings.summary_md: IBM first published this bulletin on 8 October 2026 and modified it on 23 October 2026. It records CVE-2026-84272, a CVSS 9.8 missing-authentication flaw in the Guardium edge-controller for 12.1 and 12.2.2 that lets an unauthenticated remote attacker execute arbitrary container images and take over managed edge clusters. IBM advises the 12.0p15004 Edge patch and the 12.0p147 Fix Pack, and lists no workarounds.

findings.title: Security Bulletin: IBM Guardium Data Protection is affected by multiple vulnerabilities
findings.summary_md: IBM's bulletin carries an initial publish date of 17 September 2026 and was modified on 14 October 2026. Its current text includes CVE-2026-84244, a CVSS 9.3 stored cross-site scripting flaw in the Quick Search results grid of Guardium Data Protection 12.2 that an unauthenticated attacker could trigger by influencing monitored database traffic. IBM points 12.2 users to SqlGuard_12.0p233_FixPack and lists no workarounds.

findings.title: IBM Guardium Data Protection: critical unauthenticated flaws in the Sniffer and Edge components, including path traversal to code execution and SQL injection (CVSS 9.8) and an edge-controller with no authentication that can run arbitrary containers (CVE-2026-84272, 9.8)
findings.summary_md: CyberStack published this write-up on 8 October 2026, a day before the story's first sighting. It ties IBM's two 8 October bulletins to unauthenticated Sniffer and edge-controller exposure and notes that a related September bulletin fixed CVE-2026-84249 in 12.2 and 12.2.2. The piece reports no exploitation and no vendor workarounds, and lists the Sniffer, Edge and fix-pack patch IDs while advising network restriction of collector and edge-controller management ports.

findings.title: CVE-2026-75875 | IBM Guardium Data Protection path traversal (IBM CNA record)
findings.summary_md: IBM's CVE record for CVE-2026-75875 was published at 21:29 UTC on 8 October 2026. It describes a CWE-22 path traversal in Guardium Data Protection 12.0, 12.1 and 12.2 that allows a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code, scored CVSS 9.8 with AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N. The record cites IBM bulletin 7291674 and directs users to the SqlGuard_12.0p4018_SnifferUpdate patch.

findings.title: CVE-2026-80381 | IBM Guardium Data Protection SQL injection (IBM CNA record)
findings.summary_md: IBM's CVE record for CVE-2026-80381 was published at 21:29 UTC on 8 October 2026. It describes a CWE-89 SQL injection in Guardium Data Protection 12.0, 12.1 and 12.2 that lets a remote attacker execute unauthorized SQL statements, scored CVSS 9.8 with AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N. The record references the same Sniffer bulletin and its patch, and carries no researcher credit or exploitation claim.

findings.title: CVE-2026-84272 | IBM Guardium Data Protection edge-controller missing authentication (IBM CNA record)
findings.summary_md: IBM published the CVE-2026-84272 record at 19:05 UTC on 8 October 2026. It covers CWE-306 missing authentication in the edge-controller component of Guardium Data Protection 12.1 and 12.2.2, scored CVSS 9.8, where an unauthenticated remote attacker could execute arbitrary container images and gain control of managed edge clusters. The record points to the 12.0p15004 Edge patch and the 12.0p147 Fix Pack.

findings.title: CVE-2026-84249 | IBM Guardium Data Protection management operations missing authentication (IBM CNA record)
findings.summary_md: IBM published the CVE-2026-84249 record at 21:27 UTC on 8 October 2026. It describes CWE-306 missing authentication for critical functions in Guardium Data Protection 12.2 and 12.2.2, scored CVSS 9.8, allowing a remote attacker to execute arbitrary management operations. The record lists SqlGuard_12.0p233_FixPack for 12.2 and SqlGuard_12.0p15004_Edge for 12.2.3.

findings.title: CVE-2026-84244 | IBM Guardium Data Protection Quick Search stored XSS (IBM CNA record)
findings.summary_md: IBM published the CVE-2026-84244 record at 19:08 UTC on 8 October 2026. It describes a CVSS 9.3 stored cross-site scripting flaw in the Quick Search results grid of Guardium Data Protection 12.2, where an unauthenticated attacker who can influence monitored database traffic can execute script in an authenticated user's browser. The record lists SqlGuard_12.0p233_FixPack as the fix and references IBM bulletin 7288035.
